_about: ABT, Secular Compounder, watched after a stop-out. `updates` is every Activity line on ABT from the 10-05 morning run's answer (the last answer before the 10-07 morning run) to that run, with each line's run mode joined in, as stored. Between them the principal added a buy above $100.60, changed it, removed it and added a review above $10. The 10-07 morning run (cmuy27qla001604leogd6f51o, created 12:04:10Z) saw ABT at $98.50; its read showed the add, the change and the review, not the removal, and it set a buy at $100.60 again. Built read-only on 2026-10-07.

updates.summary: Updated ABT: Removed: review every 1 days
updates.rationale:
ABT is already out on a protective stop and this review is the post-exit answer: I still do not see evidence that the core business belief broke, but I also do not see an honest re-entry plan yet. The stock is only back to $97.50, still below the 200-day, and the old $96 floor is now just noise on a watchlist name rather than real structure. Because I already treated the stop-out as price damage with belief survived, the right follow-through is to keep ABT on watch with no priced buy plan until it forms a reclaim or base worth underwriting again, not to pretend the old MA-pullback ladder still means something after it failed.

[Belief unchanged: Libre / Exact Sciences / Volt can still make this a future compounder, but the prior MA-pullback structure failed and no replacement setup exists yet.]
